title: Part 4: Light Rules Over The New World

series.summary: Light triumphs as the god of the new world while L faces his tragic demise in Silence.

cuts.voiceover_text: With his master plan set in motion, Light Yagami stands completely still in a crisp gray suit. A massive crowd of faceless dark silhouettes surrounds him. He shows zero remorse for the deadly trap he engineered. Suddenly, violent red light washes across his face. Light stares forward with a cold and menacing expression. His crimson eyes blaze with demonic intensity. The camera cuts to a colossal hall flanked by towering stone pillars. Light walks alone down the grand corridor toward a blinding white horizon. He firmly believes that he has transcended humanity to become the undisputed god of a brand new world.

In the dim shadows, Light continues his relentless advance. Dynamic split screens highlight his sharp silhouette against deep blue and crimson backdrops. He knows that every single piece of his trap has fallen perfectly into place. By manipulating Misa into using her Shinigami eyes, he has forced Rem into an inescapable corner. Rem must sacrifice her own life to save Misa by writing L's true name in her notebook. Light turns his face upward into a fiery crimson glow. A chilling smirk spreads across his face as he anticipates total victory. There is no hesitation in his eyes. His ambition has completely consumed his soul, leaving behind only ruthless calculation.

A sudden shift reveals the chilling preview for the fateful episode titled Silence. L stands completely alone on a rain-soaked rooftop under dark, stormy skies. He listens quietly to the phantom tolling of distant bells. The Japanese title Silence flashes prominently across a textured black card. The scene cuts dramatically to L collapsing onto the ground and reaching his hand outward in his final moments. Kira's merciless judgment has arrived, sealing the tragic fate of the world's greatest detective.
